customers_say: Customers find the smart lock to be of good quality, with easy installation that includes clear instructions. The lock works well with all advertised features functioning properly, and customers appreciate its multiple unlocking options and premium appearance. They consider it secure, with one customer noting it's particularly convenient for keyless entry while maintaining safety. The connectivity aspect receives mixed feedback, with some customers noting it connects via Bluetooth while others mention the lack of Wi-Fi gateway support.
